scope: Original neutral reconstruction of an early western black clamshell, suitable for the existing Sonic the Hedgehog PAL cartridge reproduction.

sources.type: Scanned original Sonic the Hedgehog PAL instruction manual, rehosted by Sonic Retro
observations: The original front cover is a single landscape layout; extracted raster aspect is approximately 1939:1102.
Stored sideways at an estimated 164 mm long edge, this implies a 93.2 mm short edge and avoids stretching the manual cover.
sources.limitations: The aspect ratio is observed from the scan. Physical size, thickness and lateral placement remain estimates; no page artwork is included in the neutral template.

observations: Black molded clamshell with a broad flat spine and two thin flexible folds.
Cartridge stored sideways relative to the upright portrait cover.
Two opposing cartridge guide brackets with central spring tongues.
Four raised booklet retaining tongues and two small hinge-side stops.
Intact retail hanger on the top body edge and shallow circular tooling witness marks.
sources.limitations: Oblique photograph, no ruler; used for construction and relative layout only. Wear and manufacturing logos are not copied.

sources.type: Firsthand auction catalogue description of an original specimen
observations: Identifies the original black plastic case, paper cover inlay, instruction manual and cartridge.
Identifies PAL European packaging with multilingual back text, product code 670-1470-50S, and a case hanging tab.
sources.limitations: Corroborates packaging construction and edition family, not the exact mold variant or dimensions.

observations: Published fit envelope supplies a plausible scale for the standard closed body.
sources.limitations: Search-indexed manufacturer text was accessible; direct product URL returned 404 during review. This is a protector fit envelope, not an original Sega manufacturing drawing.

sources.type: Original Japanese case specimen photograph, construction comparison only
observations: Clear view of open U-shaped cartridge guides, spring tongues and through-slots.
Clear view of hollow shell perimeter, booklet tongues and dual spine flexures.
sources.limitations: Japanese specimen is not asserted to be the same PAL mold. Used only to understand structural features independently visible in the Sonic PAL photo.

dimensionConfidence: All modeled dimensions are nominal visualization estimates. No claim of caliper measurement, factory accuracy, universal case compatibility or print-ready die-cut accuracy is made.

articulation.mechanism: Two rigid pivot approximations of flexible polypropylene folds. The open endpoint is a flat 180-degree spread; material bending is not simulated.

artworkContract.uv: Each named surface has upright normalized UV coordinates and its own material.
artworkContract.wrap: The original continuous paper wrap is split at the two flexures to retain clean articulated surfaces.
artworkContract.clearSleeve: Independent transparent faces above the paper; alpha blending is a portable approximation of a thin transparent flexible sleeve.
artworkContract.condition: Fresh, unprinted stock. No yellowing, scratches, abrasion, stains or simulated age.

knownApproximations: Early western molds vary; this reconstruction captures the inspected construction without claiming an exact manufacturing revision.
The projecting retail hanger follows the inspected Sonic specimen. Other molds have different, foldable or removed hangers.
Cartridge clip offsets, snap catches, witness marks, page count, sleeve thickness and retail hanger size are inferred from photographs.
The separate booklet matches the observed Sonic PAL manual cover aspect ratio, with estimated physical dimensions and thickness; it does not reproduce the manual pagination.
Embossed manufacturer names, logos and mold identifiers are intentionally absent from the neutral template.
No cartridge mesh is included; CartridgePlacement exposes the sideways insertion anchor for the existing media asset.
rights: References were inspected to author new parametric geometry. No reference photograph, game artwork, scanned mesh or third-party logo is embedded or redistributed in this template.
